summary: Ask a question, then read and navigate the answer with touch controls.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who wants to ask a question and read the answer on e-ink.
job: Ask a question, then read and navigate the answer with touch controls.
offline: Nothing works without the network; asking is the job.

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to send your question and bring back the answer

non_goals: It does not keep a conversation history.
It does not answer without being asked.
